messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: starlight-prod (Private VPC) showing elevated 5xx from NLB -> targets intermittently failing healthchecks in us-west-2. Customer on Dedicated pool. Impact: API errors ~1.4% (>1% alert). Please triage.
Alice (eng-oncall): I'm on it, pulling up NLB target health and SG changes. @Bob can you check recent SG pushes in that VPC?
Bob (netops): I saw an automated security update at ~10:12 that tightened ephemeral port egress from the worker subnets to 1024-65535 -> restricted to a narrower range. Could break healthcheck responses if source port mapping changes. Investigating.
Alice (eng-oncall): Copy. Getting target group health history...
Alice (eng-oncall): Health check pattern looks like: healthy->unhealthy flaps every ~30s across multiple AZs. Health check path /hc returns 200 locally. Logs show connection resets.
Mike (sre): Could be TCP ephemeral port mismatch with NLB healthchecks. NLB healthchecks come from AWS health IPs, but if SG is too tight we may block return flow.
Carla (acct-eng): FYI customer noticed increased errors and opened a support ticket. They want ETA. I'll keep them updated.
Bob (netops): Confirmed: SG rule 203 in the vpc-securitygroup-starlight-workers was changed by automation. Before: allow ephemeral 1024-65535 outbound to 0.0.0.0/0. After: allow 30000-40000 only. I can open a rollback.
Alice (eng-oncall): Good catch. We should restore previous ephemeral range as hotfix. But legal/infra may have restricted range for compliance — discuss after. Immediate mitigation: rollback SG to previous rule and re-evaluate.
Sam (platform): Rolling rollback now via infra runbook. Command: `terraform apply -target=aws_security_group_rule.sg_ephemeral_203 -var='env=starlight'` — running in batch.
deploy-bot: Run started by Sam: infra/terraform/starlight (plan id: tf-789).
Alice (eng-oncall): While that runs, can we shift NLB weight to us-east-1 region replica to reduce customer errors? DNS is Route53 weighted record pointing 90 us-west, 10 us-east. Suggest 50/50 to drain pressure. @Mike can you coordinate?
Mike (sre): I can push weighted shift. Applying change: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123 --change-batch file://wshift.json` (wshift: us-west 50, us-east 50). Propagation should be a few seconds to minutes depending on caching.
Bob (netops): Terraform rollback completed; SG rule reverted to 1024-65535 outbound. I also added a temporary explicit allow for NLB healthcheck CIDR ranges (x.x.x.x/32,y.y.y.y/32) for extra safety.
Alice (eng-oncall): Good. Watching target group health...
Alice (eng-oncall): Targets marked healthy across AZs, 200s returning. Error rate dropping from 1.4% -> 0.3% over the last 2 minutes.
Carla (acct-eng): Notifying customer: "We rolled back a security rule that impacted healthchecks and shifted traffic while we mitigated. Errors are dropping; monitoring continues. Will follow up with root cause and remediation plan."
Mike (sre): DNS weight change shows propagation. Traffic flow leveling out. We'll keep watch for 30m, if stable then we can revert weights.
Sam (platform): Filed infra postmortem ticket INFRA-912 in backlog to add safeguards: require canary for SG changes in private tenant VPCs and a pre-change test to run healthcheck simulation.
Alice (eng-oncall): Agreed. Also adding a follow-up to add an automated lint rule on SG ephemeral ranges for private deployments.
deploy-bot: Run completed: infra/terraform/starlight (plan id: tf-789) — apply succeeded.
Bob (netops): I pushed a note to the automation team to pause widening of ephemeral ranges until we add the safety checks.
Alice (eng-oncall): Final status: customer-facing errors returned to baseline. Rolling this to resolved unless we see re-flaps. Will create incident postmortem doc with timeline, root cause (automation narrowed SG ephemeral ports), mitigation (rollback + explicit NLB CIDR allow + temporary DNS weighting), and remediation actions (canary, lint).
Carla (acct-eng): Sending final note to customer with timeline and next steps. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> monitoring.
Alice (eng-oncall): Handoff to next oncall @Mike in 30m. I'm leaving notes in the incident board.
Mike (sre): Taking watch. If anything creeps up I'll reopen the thread.
Sam (platform): Adding runbook PR to infra repo with explicit healthcheck tests.
Alice (eng-oncall): Thanks all.
Carla (acct-eng): Thanks.
